disposition_reason: Rat nephrotoxicity study of ammonium metavanadate in drinking water with a mallow decoction; oxidative-stress and histology endpoints, no vanadium measured in any matrix.

study.method: TBARS, SOD, CAT, GPX spectrophotometry; serum creatinine kit; H&E histology

unresolved: Dose statements in abstract and methods are inconsistent and not reconciled by the paper.
regulatory_or_exposure: Dose: ammonium metavanadate 1.185 mmol/L as sole beverage, stated as 60 mg ammonium metavanadate/kg bw (p. 6); abstract states 0.24 mmol/kg bw (p. 1)
non_numeric_findings: Day 30: kidney TBARS about 117.5% above controls; SOD, CAT, GPX up 74.5%, 31.5%, 82% (pp. 2 to 3)
Structural deterioration of renal cortical capsules and reduced Bowman's space; serum creatinine unchanged (pp. 2 to 3)
